rules.title: Measure before you write
rules.text: Every figure comes from a named build, measured on a named date, and the way it was measured is stated. A figure not measured on this device is attributed to where it came from: an earlier build, or the app's own development notes.

rules.title: Say exactly what was measured
rules.text: Write "on opening" when a measurement was made on opening. When an app checks its own helper at the device's loopback address, write "no request to any outside service" and name that check; never write that it makes no request at all.

rules.title: Keep the owner's words
rules.text: Change only what a new build has made untrue. Keep the owner's voice, structure and sentences wherever the facts still hold.

rules.title: Lector stays out of academic documents
rules.text: Dossiers, appendices and supplements never name Lector, the part of Ingenium that drafts documents.

rules.title: Sociology documents stay with the instrument
rules.text: Documents for a sociology doctorate describe Carpe Diem and The Forge only; Ingenium and Inkwell stay out of them and out of the sociology CV.

rules.title: Cite only what is verified
rules.text: Cite a source only from the verified list or from the owner's own sources in Fontes, and only for the claim it supports. Name a preprint as a preprint and a correlational study as correlational. Invent nothing.

rules.title: No claim beyond the measure
rules.text: Make no claim of parity with a product that was not measured, and no superlative without a measure beside it.

rules.title: State the limits
rules.text: State limitations in advance, and offer any optional role of an app for the committee's consideration rather than assume it.

rules.title: The owner's style
rules.text: British spelling; short sentences; no dashes in prose; the academic voice; no promotional words. In academic documents, "the applicant" rather than a pronoun; in employment documents, the owner's first person.

rules.title: Leave gaps rather than guess
rules.text: Where a fact about the owner is not in the material, leave a short bracketed gap for the owner to fill, such as [start date].

rules.title: Never write over
rules.text: Every update is kept as a new version; the version before it stays.
